note: One vocabulary for CI and release output in every repo. The executor has its own, larger catalog (automationpc-platform executor/contract/reason_codes.json); these are the ones a repo's own CI and scripts emit.

codes.next_action: agent: read the failing test names in the log, fix the code or the test, push; do not retry the run
agent: a data file failed its schema or invariant check; the detail names the file; fix the file
agent: a workflow would use a billed hosted runner; use the self-hosted runner label or remove the job
agent: a secret-shaped string is in the change; remove it, rotate it if it was ever pushed, never paste it in chat
owner: the change touches a protected path; open the PR with the needs-owner-approval label and the owner approves it on GitHub
agent: platform/work-items.json does not match work-item.schema.json; run work_items.py check and fix the named item
agent: another worker holds this item; pick a different one with work_items.py next
wait: required checks have not finished for this commit; retry when they complete
agent: the release lane refused this commit; its reason code and detail are in the release log; fix the cause
agent: the release failed and the previous version was restored; fix the change and release again
owner: approve the pull request on GitHub (signed in as the owner); the next run proceeds
agent: an unclassified failure; read the log and add a specific code to the kit if it will happen again
